findings.title: target containment semantics (carried cycle-1 F2/R2)
findings.detail: A middle row containing 儲存全部 plus extra CJK glyphs is accepted (probes: 儲存全部相簿 -> ELIGIBLE; 不儲存全部 -> ELIGIBLE). Identical semantics to frozen v7 exact substring containment; no CJK substitution, insertion or deletion inside the target occurrence is ever accepted; bounded by the exact five-row order, the middle position and the outside live-route gates.

findings.title: non-CJK stripping inside the target occurrence (carried cycle-1 F3/R3)
findings.detail: Punctuation noise inside the target occurrence (儲存全.部) is accepted because matching runs on CJK-only row text. This widening versus v7 is limited to non-CJK noise and cannot admit a substituted or truncated CJK target; it covers the observed trailing-noise class (選擇項目-, 刪除相簿t).

findings.title: documentation precision: one-glyph CJK insertions in non-target rows
findings.detail: The tolerant matcher scans length-equal windows, so a non-target row with one inserted CJK glyph can also pass (probe 修改相簿名和稱 -> ELIGIBLE), and exact containment accepts rows of any length containing the reference item. Plan §3 and the tool docstring phrase the boundary as length-equal windows with no insertions/deletions; the effective accepted class is slightly wider. Target identity, structure, order, target position and geometry remain hard, so this is a wording precision nit, not a safety change.

findings.title: extra non-CJK rows are not counted as item rows
findings.detail: An extra OCR row with no CJK text inside the menu bbox does not affect the five-CJK-item structure check (probe: extra Latin row -> ELIGIBLE). The candidate stays bounded to the exact target row band, so no wrong-row redirect was demonstrated; this class is outside the enumerated negative matrix and belongs to the acknowledged near-identical-menu residual.
